findings.reason: an author who saw the existing held-out ladder fitter would extend it (and only add the third-mesh term the `c-20260823T0935` circularity note demands) instead of dispatching a fresh instrument.
findings.text: the released node `f-dfo-error-estimator-now` asks to "build the independent same-observable discretisation-error estimator" but the plan text (grep for `derived_convergence`, `richardson`, `criterion_provenance`, `efit_operator_consolidation` returns 0 hits) never cites the instrument family that already derives exactly this: `benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py` ("Derive a fixed-point criterion from held-out banked mesh ladders"), `benchmarks/derived_criterion_family.py` ("rebuilds ... the DIII-D convergence ... criteria from their measurement domains"), `benchmarks/efit_parity_criterion_provenance.py:398 richardson_fine_error`, and `benchmarks/efit_operator_consistency_order.py:60 _fit_power_order`; further resolution-ladder machinery already exists in `benchmarks/wall_resolution_ladder.py`, `benchmarks/topology_read_resolution_ladder.py`, `benchmarks/topology_qualified_mesh_convergence.py` and `benchmarks/order_vs_mesh_adjudication.py`

findings.reason: naming `derived_convergence_criterion.py` as the owner turns the node from "build an estimator" into "add the one missing term to the existing estimator", which is the change the adjudication actually asked for and avoids a second instrument drifting from the first.
findings.text: the estimator node is a second owner of the criterion-derivation mechanism whose existing owner is `benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py` (line 141 `_fit_held_out_ladder`, line 225 `_fit_qualification`), which already fits a power order from held-out banked mesh ladders and refuses the quantity it tests by construction; the plan should extend that owner to add the non-circular third-spacing/`h`-independent estimate the `c-20260823T0935-criterion-correction` comment says is still missing, rather than fork a parallel estimator

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the §5 extraction surface is one module (`nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.py`) hiding the Δ* application, per-surface separation, vacuum-region receipt and chord sampling behind four functions, and the consolidation comment (`c-20260817-extraction-consolidation`) records that it delegates Δ* to `nova/equilibrium/conservation.py` rather than re-implementing it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the estimator node duplicates the criterion-derivation owner already in `benchmarks/`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the live nodes add a benchmark instrument and internal modules, not public API, and §7 names the MAST-specific path it retires (`nova/scripts/mast_machine_artifact.py`, generalised onto `nova/imas/machine_artifact.py`).
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan ran reuse maps for the solver-stability wave (§5 comments cite `scripts/forward_stability_survey/report.md`, 126 valid citations) and correctly cites the extraction machinery it hardens, but the released estimator node (`f-dfo-error-estimator-now`) proposes a new discretisation-error instrument without citing the benchmark instrument family that already does it, and the plan text names none of those modules.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the open nodes do not add a thin layer over a single existing call; the estimator adds measurement, not a forwarding wrapper, so the defect it carries is a duplicate owner rather than a wrapper.
